  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.team-grid .person');
  bar.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const btn = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!btn) return;
    bar.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('is-active'); });
    btn.classList.add('is-active');

## The hubs

```{=html}
<div class="hubs-intro">
  <div>
    <p>Each hub builds local modelling capacity while sharing methods, data and lessons across the network. Tanzania coordinates; the DRC and Nigeria anchor the work in different ecological and epidemiological settings.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="hubs-map-wrap">
    <img class="hubs-map" src="assets/africa-hubs-map-green.png" alt="MoDD Africa hubs: Nigeria, DR Congo and Tanzania highlighted on the map of Africa.">
    <button class="hub-pin" type="button" data-group="nigeria" style="left:40%; top:35%" aria-expanded="false"><span class="hub-pin__dot"></span><span class="hub-pin__label">Nigeria</span></button>
    <button class="hub-pin" type="button" data-group="drc" style="left:57%; top:59%" aria-expanded="false"><span class="hub-pin__dot"></span><span class="hub-pin__label">DR Congo</span></button>
    <button class="hub-pin" type="button" data-group="tanzania" style="left:72%; top:61%" aria-expanded="false"><span class="hub-pin__dot"></span><span class="hub-pin__label">Tanzania</span></button>
    <div class="hub-popover" hidden>
      <button class="hub-popover__close" type="button" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
      <div class="hub-popover__head"></div>
      <div class="hub-popover__people"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="hubcards">
  <div class="hubcard">
    <img src="assets/feature-project.jpg" alt="Ifakara Health Institute, Tanzania.">
    <div class="hubcard__body">
      <span class="tag">Coordinating hub</span>
      <h3>Tanzania — Ifakara Health Institute</h3>
      <p>Hosts the project as regional coordinator and main recipient of funds, leading efforts to establish the hubs and build regional capacity.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hubcard">
    <img src="assets/hub-drc.jpg" alt="National Institute for Biomedical Research, DR Congo.">
    <div class="hubcard__body">
      <h3>DR Congo — INRB</h3>
      <p>Runs the DRC hub from the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB), in one of the highest-burden malaria settings on the continent.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hubcard">
    <img src="assets/nimr-adedapo.jpeg" alt="Dr Adedapo Adeogun at the Nigerian Institute of Medical Research (NIMR).">
    <div class="hubcard__body">
      <h3>Nigeria — NIMR</h3>
      <p>Runs the Nigeria hub from the Nigerian Institute of Medical Research (NIMR), bringing the network into West Africa's distinct transmission and health-system context.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const wrap = document.querySelector('.hubs-map-wrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  const pins = wrap.querySelectorAll('.hub-pin');
  const pop = wrap.querySelector('.hub-popover');
  const head = pop.querySelector('.hub-popover__head');
  const list = pop.querySelector('.hub-popover__people');
  const closeBtn = pop.querySelector('.hub-popover__close');
  const HUB_LABEL = { nigeria: 'Nigeria hub', drc: 'DR Congo hub', tanzania: 'Tanzania hub' };
  let activePin = null;

  function closePopover() {
    pop.hidden = true;
    if (activePin) { activePin.classList.remove('is-active'); activePin.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
    activePin = null;
  }

  function openPopover(pin) {
    const group = pin.dataset.group;
    const people = document.querySelectorAll('.team-grid .person[data-group="' + group + '"]');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    people.forEach(function (p) {
      const img = p.querySelector('img.avatar');
      const initials = p.querySelector('div.avatar');
      const name = p.querySelector('h3') ? p.querySelector('h3').textContent : '';
      const role = p.querySelector('.role') ? p.querySelector('.role').textContent : '';
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'hub-popover__person';
      const avatarHtml = img ? '<img src="' + img.getAttribute('src') + '" alt="">' : '<div class="avatar-sm">' + (initials ? initials.textContent : '') + '</div>';
      row.innerHTML = avatarHtml + '<div><h4>' + name + '</h4><p>' + role + '</p></div>';
      list.appendChild(row);
    });
    head.textContent = HUB_LABEL[group] || group;

    pins.forEach(function (p) { p.classList.remove('is-active'); p.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); });
    pin.classList.add('is-active');
    pin.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    activePin = pin;
    pop.hidden = false;

    pop.style.left = '0px';
    pop.style.top = '0px';
    const wrapRect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pinRect = pin.getBoundingClientRect();
    const popRect = pop.getBoundingClientRect();
    let left = (pinRect.left - wrapRect.left) - popRect.width / 2 + pinRect.width / 2;
    const top = (pinRect.bottom - wrapRect.top) + 14;
    const minLeft = -(wrapRect.left) + 8;
    const maxLeft = (window.innerWidth - wrapRect.left) - popRect.width - 8;
    left = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(left, maxLeft));
    pop.style.left = left + 'px';
    pop.style.top = top + 'px';
  }

  pins.forEach(function (pin) {
    pin.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (activePin === pin) { closePopover(); return; }
      openPopover(pin);
    });
  });
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closePopover);
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!pop.hidden && !wrap.contains(e.target)) closePopover(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closePopover(); });
})();
</script>
```
